start_candidate:
Welcome to SrokWork! 🇰🇭

Send me your CV (PDF, photo, or just describe your experience in a message). I'll create your profile so employers can find you.

Commands:
/profile — view or edit your profile
/help — get help
/mydata — export or delete your data
start_employer:
Welcome, employer! 🇰🇭

Describe the candidate you need — in Khmer or English. For example:
• "I need a cook in Siem Reap under $400"
• "តួនាទីបុគ្គលិកលក់ ភ្នំពេញ"

I'll find matching profiles instantly.

Commands:
/search — start a new search
/alerts — manage saved alerts
/help — get help
ask_role: Are you looking for work, or hiring?
cv_received: Got it. Reading your CV now... ⏳
cv_published:
Your profile is live ✨

Employers can now find you. You'll be notified when someone is interested.
search_no_results:
No matches yet — but I'll alert you when a candidate matches your search.

Tap below to save this as an alert.
alert_saved: Alert saved. I'll message you when new candidates match.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
help:
SrokWork helps Cambodians find work and SMEs find people.

— It's free, forever.
— Available on Telegram, Messenger, and web.
— Built in Cambodia.

For support: github.com/YOUR-ORG/srokwork-core/issues
